name: qfd_dv_slice2_stn8-g2-COMMIT
purpose: QW-SLICE3: slice2 station, 8 regional CTS roots (one per SU-lane region), landed fault ring

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qfd_dv_redstn2_rg8 #(.PIN_IN(1), .BT_LAT(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_dv/qfd_dv_redstn2_rg8.sv rtl/qwen_dv/qfd_dv_redstn2_regional.sv rtl/qwen_dv/qfd_dv_redstn2_gsafe.sv rtl/qwen_dv/qfd_dv_station_math_g.sv rtl/qwen_dv/qfd_dv_ring_delay.sv rtl/qwen_dv/qfd_dv_reset_tree.sv rtl/common/landed_parent/ot_pl_land.sv rtl/common/landed_parent/ot_pl_land_physical.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_mul_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_32x64_m1/ot_sram_1r1w_32x64_m1_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_dv_slice2_stn8/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_dv_slice2_stn8/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_dv_slice2_stn8 --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_dv_redstn2_rg8 --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_32x64_m1 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
